app.name: Tock
app.one_liner: Tock is a powerful time tracking tool for the command line that saves activity logs as plaintext files and provides an interactive terminal UI for viewing your time.

screens.name: Interactive Calendar View
screens.purpose: Display time entries in a calendar-based terminal interface with support for navigation, filtering by tags, and visual theming.

rust_commands.name: apply_tag_colors
rust_commands.purpose: Assign and render custom colors per tag in the TUI based on configuration.

rust_commands.name: export_report
rust_commands.purpose: Export time entries within a specified date range (--from/--to) in text, CSV, JSON, or iCal format.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Record a new time entry with optional tags, notes, and duration (supporting decimal hours).

mvp_plan: week 1: Add support for tagging and notes
week 1: Build basic TUI calendar view using Bubble Tea
week 1: Implement core time entry storage with flat-file backend
acceptance_tests: Decimal durations (e.g., 1.5h) are accepted and displayed accurately.
Tag colors configured in tock.yaml are rendered correctly in the terminal UI.
User can export entries between --from and --to dates in CSV format.
User can log a time entry with multiple tags and verify it appears in the TUI.
